repos.name: datawhalechina/agentic-rl-lab
repos.description: Reproducing and studying RL algorithms for LLM agents, including GRPO, GSPO, DAPO, OPD, Search-R1, ReTool, ALFWorld and beyond.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive research repository for reproducing and studying Reinforcement Learning algorithms specifically designed for LLM agents.
bullets: Built on Python with a focus on advanced RL frameworks like GRPO, GSPO, and DAPO.
Provides a structured environment for benchmarking agentic reasoning and search capabilities.
Ideal for developers building autonomous agents that require complex decision-making and self-correction.
Includes implementations for ALFWorld and other complex task-solving environments.

repos.name: FlashML-org/FreeToken
repos.description: FreeToken brings datacenter-scale model serving to your desktop. Run massive models locally, fast and efficiently.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance local inference engine designed to bring datacenter-scale model serving capabilities to consumer hardware.
bullets: Optimized for low-latency, high-throughput local LLM execution on desktop environments.
Focuses on efficient memory management and quantization techniques to run massive models locally.
Serves as critical infrastructure for developers building privacy-first or offline AI applications.
Reduces dependency on cloud-based APIs, lowering costs and latency for AI-driven workflows.

repos.name: scenario-labs/skills
repos.description: Get production-ready images, video, audio, and 3D from any AI agent: skills that pick the right model, price before spending, and keep characters and brands consistent through the Scenario MCP, plus expert teams that drive Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity.
repos.one_liner: A toolkit providing production-ready AI agent skills for generating consistent media assets across images, video, and 3D.
bullets: Integrates with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to allow agents to interact with external creative tools.
Features cost-estimation logic to manage token usage and budget before executing generative tasks.
Ensures brand and character consistency through standardized agentic workflows.
Targeted at developers building automated creative pipelines for marketing or content production.

repos.name: thtbee/nectarlink
repos.description: Your Android phone and your Windows PC, working as one. Local-first, end-to-end encrypted, no account.
repos.one_liner: A local-first, end-to-end encrypted bridge between Android devices and Windows PCs.
bullets: Written in Rust for high performance and memory safety in cross-device communication.
Operates entirely locally without requiring cloud accounts or external servers.
Provides a secure infrastructure layer for syncing data and controlling mobile devices from a desktop.
Useful for professionals requiring secure, private data management between mobile and desktop environments.
